description: We are SOUTHPOLE SENTINELS - a 6-member global team from India & Kazakhstan. For Lunar Landing Site Navigator, we are building a simple tool to find safe landing sites at Moon's South Pole. Guarding Every Landing. We love coding, design & storytelling. We are here make every landing safe.
summary:
Descendra is a tool we built for predicting safe landing on the lunar surface. Landing on the Moon is not easy, so we check many technical things before saying a site is safe. We look at surface slope in degrees, distance from hazards like craters and boulders, sunlight availability, and Permanently Shadowed Regions (PSR). Using all these parameters, our machine learning model predicts if a landing site is safe or risky.

We also built three more tools. First, a Rover Path Planner that finds a safe route by avoiding obstacles, so the rover can move easily on the surface. Second, a Shadow Simulator that shows how surface illumination changes with sun elevation. Third, a Communication Tool that estimates Earth-Moon communication visibility using a simplified horizon visibility model.

We also made a 3D model of the Moon showing Shiv Shakti Point, where Chandrayaan-3 landed. We are highly inspired by Chandrayaan-3 and its data. Our goal is simple - to help ISRO and NASA predict better landing sites.
details:
DESCENDRA - Lunar Landing Navigator

What does it do?

DESCENDRA predicts the safest landing spot on the Moon before we land. The user enters a landing site's data and gets a Safety Score out of 100. For example, our demo site scored 89/100 - Good for Landing.

How does it work?

Our Landing Safety Predictor checks 5 key factors: Slope, Hazard Distance, Roughness, Sunlight Availability, and PSR (Permanently Shadowed Region). It also has a Comparison Mode to compare 2-3 sites and choose the safest one. We validated it against Chandrayaan-3's Shiv Shakti Point, which scored 90/100 as a reference. Our test site scored 89/100, almost as safe as Chandrayaan-3.

Other Tools:

1. 3D Moon Viewer - Full 3D Moon, rotate and zoom, with a glowing marker for Shiv Shakti Point.

2. Rover Path Planner - Plans a safe route for the rover avoiding obstacles.

3. Shadow Simulator - Shows how sunlight and shadows change with Sun elevation.

4. Earth-Moon Communication Tool - Shows Earth-Moon visibility using a simplified horizon model.

What is the benefit and impact?

Landing is the most dangerous part of a Moon mission. Even today, around 30% of Moon missions fail during landing. DESCENDRA can help ISRO and NASA choose safer landing sites for future astronauts, landers, and rovers, saving missions, time, and money.

What tools did we use?

We built it with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Vite, and Three.js for the 3D Moon. Data is inspired by real NASA lunar data and Chandrayaan-3 landing data.

We used Super Intelligence (AI) tools like Meta AI and ChatGPT as helpers during the project. We used them for brainstorming the DESCENDRA idea, researching NASA lunar landing data and Chandrayaan-3 information, and editing our project summary and presentation text to make it clear and simple.

The core idea, design, logic for the Safety Score, comparison with Chandrayaan-3, 3D Moon Viewer, Rover Path Planner, Shadow Simulator, and Communication Tool, and all coding, fixing errors, debugging, and testing were done by our team with help from our seniors. AI did not build the project by itself. We checked all AI suggestions ourselves before using them.

Why is it creative?

Instead of just showing a map, we give a simple Safety Score that anyone can understand, plus comparison with a real successful mission - Chandrayaan-3. It is easy for students, teams, and mission planners to use.

Live Demo: https://descendra.vercel.app/
